label: Indexed capacity correspondence and information preservation
paraphrase: For arbitrary scenario, event, situation, bearer and specified-respect types and explicit index maps, an event capacity profile has an exactly corresponding situation/bearer/respect capacity precisely when it agrees on every pair identified by all three maps; the existential image supplies such a capacity under that condition. An arbitrary event profile is recovered without this condition by retaining the event identity alongside its respect and preserving scenarios and actual bearers. A thin world/bearer profile is recovered from its one-respect embedding. Exact correspondence preserves the existing Borrowed, Retained and PowerRequired formulas. The one-respect round trip preserves the existing Eleatic existence-to-power, intellectual-exercise-to-power and power-to-concreteness formulas, without proving any of those premises. Two Boolean controls reject arbitrary event collapse and arbitrary scenario collapse; retaining different respects permits different powers of one bearer. The existing capOccurs/capAll regress contrast and PowerOmission are reused unchanged. Possession remains primitive; no activation, actual-world applicability, existential support or root discharge follows.
